title: Two Injured After Fire Damages Laredo Home on Messi Street
excerpt: Two people were injured — one taken to a hospital — after a fire broke out at a home in the 2500 block of Messi Street on Sunday night, according to the Laredo Fire Department.
content:
Two people were injured after a fire broke out at a home in the 2500 block of Messi Street on Sunday night, according to KGNS.

The Laredo Fire Department said firefighters were dispatched to the home at 2519 Messi St. and found heavy smoke and flames coming from the house. Crews quickly contained the fire to the back bedroom, according to the department.

Both people hurt in the fire had minor injuries, the department said. One of them was taken to a hospital for treatment.

The home sustained fire, smoke and water damage. The cause of the fire was not known, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 23, 2026.
